summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-03 at src/design/adp-03-tenant-context-resolution-api.md. The design defines deterministic tenant resolution from bearer token claims with default-tenant fallback, strict request-scope tenant isolation invariants, middleware/service/repository boundary contracts, validation and error outcomes for missing or invalid tenant context, and explicit traceability to API-08, OIDC-13, ADP-01, and ADP-02.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified required sections (purpose, interfaces, data flow, error taxonomy, state transitions, dependencies, open questions) and mapped all handoff acceptance criteria to explicit design sections.
